description: Atlyn Marimekko displays nonnegative additive values as variable-width, 100% stacked columns. Bind a Segment, Component, and Additive value measure, then confirm that the measure can be summed across both dimensions. Column width shows the segment share of the supplied total. Component height shows its share within the segment, so rectangle area shows overall contribution. Model-formatted values and separate segment and overall shares are available in labels, native tooltips, and a paginated data table. Use it for product-region revenue composition and business-unit product mix. Missing observations are distinguished from measured zeros. Invalid or nonadditive percentage inputs are not silently converted into a valid composition. When Power BI returns incomplete or reduced data, displayed-subset warnings identify denominator limitations. Authors remain responsible for measure additivity, model filters, and business meaning. Tiny columns are not artificially widened; labels appear only where they fit, and retained observations remain available in the table. The visual supports native selection identities, keyboard controls, high-contrast patterns, English and French UI, RTL layout, and compact presentation. Runtime rendering is local with no external requests, telemetry, remote assets, or licensing backend. It supports up to 200 segments, 40 components, and 4,000 cells…
